description: #183: one verdict per dependent (82 units: remote code, docs and measured forced tests): is the file affected by the stated change at all? A test forced by a failing assertion counts only where the task text states the behaviour it contradicts (quote from the text); one forced by compilation stays. An agent's judgement, with the reviewer's of pull request #206; no arm's result was used. `commit_replay.py build` reads `counts`.
